xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5290: Workflow redesign C: code opens beside the chat; edit-workspace bar, Create PR and PR status in the editor; stale tabs

plan.title: Workflow redesign C: code opens beside the chat; edit-workspace bar, Create PR and PR status in the editor; stale tabs
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: Files already open beside the chat (child B), but the code pane shows a raw path and a lone Changes toggle, nothing marks the lines the conversation changed, the edit-workspace and PR flow lives in a Files-tab banner instead of the editor, the Create PR dialog shows neither the files nor the landing question, a tab of a merged or discarded edit workspace shows 'Couldn't open file', and the cursor jumps to line 1 when the first edit moves the pane to an edit workspace.
narratives.Proposal: Per .pan/drafts/pan-5290.md: a breadcrumb/File-Changes/Reveal header; gutter marks from a new git-blame route GET /api/conversations/:name/changes/lines; an EditorBar in every code pane on a project or edit root that carries Start editing, the editing state with files and +/- from a new GET /api/explorer/edit-workspaces/:id/changes route, Discard, Create PR, PR states with a 15 s refresh while blocked, and landed notes after merge/pipeline/discard; a view-state registry so cursor, scroll and focus survive the root switch; a redesigned Create PR dialog; a stale-tab state; the banner removed from the Files tab with New edit workspace in its root menu; a fixture-backed Playwright spec with screenshots; docs and changelog.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Real-GitHub PR runs inside pipeline UAT (parent D-12; the epic owner runs them after merge)
- Check counts ('3 of 9 done') or a merge sha in the merged note (C-D7; no contract data)
- Chat file-path chips that open diffs or files (child D2, parent FR-4)
- +/- counts in the dock Changes tab for issue or edit-workspace roots
- Breadcrumb, editor bar or gutter marks for viewer-only files (images, PDFs, archives)
- Gutter marks for issue-agent or project-main scopes, or inside the Changes diff view
- Per-line attribution for non-Claude harnesses beyond attribution 'file' (parent D-5)
- Persisting landed notes across a reload
- Any polling faster than 15 s, or polling while no editor bar for that workspace is mounted
- Ledger theme parity beyond not breaking
- Raising any scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt row

autoDecisions.summary: Gutter line numbers come from a new server route that uses git blame on the working tree (C-D2)
autoDecisions.rationale: Commit hunks carry line numbers as of their own commit and the written-line evidence is server-side only; blame plus written lines is exact for commits and for the shared-file case the fixture pins (21-24 vs 25-26).

autoDecisions.summary: Edit-workspace +/- counts come from a new GET /api/explorer/edit-workspaces/:id/changes route measured against the merge base with origin/<default> (C-D5)
autoDecisions.rationale: Git status carries no line counts; one cheap server call covers untracked and binary files, never calls gh, and matches what commitAll ships with git add -A.

autoDecisions.summary: PR status refetches every 15 s only while an editor bar is mounted and the PR is open, not a draft, not mergeable, and GitHub reports UNKNOWN or BLOCKED (C-D6)
autoDecisions.rationale: FR-16 needs the state to advance by itself; each read calls gh, and a draft, conflicting or out-of-date PR cannot change without the operator, so polling it would only spend GitHub quota.

autoDecisions.summary: Mockup details without data are replaced: no check counts, no merge sha, a save-state word instead of 'saved 1 s ago' (C-D7)
autoDecisions.rationale: EditWorkspacePr has no check counts and the merge route returns no sha; adding them is contract work the PRD's FRs do not require.

autoDecisions.summary: Create PR keeps Description, push mode and per-choice disabled reasons (C-D8)
autoDecisions.rationale: Parent D-14: nothing is deleted without a home; these functions exist today and the mockup simply omits them.

autoDecisions.summary: EditWorkspaceBanner and PrStatusRow are deleted; the Files tab mounts the same EditorBar on an edit root and gains New edit workspace in its root menu; their tests are ported to EditorBar.test.tsx (C-D10)
autoDecisions.rationale: Parent §7 moves the banner's functions to the editor bar; a tree-only edit creates an edit workspace with no code pane, so the Files tab must keep Create PR reachable (parent D-13/D-14); the test-skip gate counts deleted tests.

autoDecisions.summary: A code pane's scoped conversation is the first other layout leaf bound to a conversation, exposed as StageDeckContext.conversationBeside (C-D3)
autoDecisions.rationale: It is the dock's own rule 5, and the dock's changed paths are empty while the dock is closed.

autoDecisions.summary: The lines route caches its answer per conversation and file, keyed by HEAD, the file stat and the transcript stat (C-D2b)
autoDecisions.rationale: /changes refetches every 5 s while a conversation works and the client lines query follows it; without a cache every refetch would spawn git blame.

autoDecisions.summary: Server and contract edits outside the stub's owned-file list are in scope (C-D14)
autoDecisions.rationale: Children A and B that own those files are merged and no open follow-up (PAN-5334, PAN-5335) touches them; the FRs cannot be met client-side.

autoDecisions.summary: Browser UAT reaches PR states with page.route stubs; the edit workspace, changes route and stale tab run for real (C-D15)
autoDecisions.rationale: The workflow fixture has a bare origin and no GitHub repository, so PR creation and merge cannot happen for real in pipeline UAT.

metadata.sizeJustification: Child C of the PAN-5284 epic, already split from the epic by the operator's order book. The editor bar, the Create PR dialog, the stale tab and the removal of the Files-tab banner must ship together so the dashboard keeps a working Create PR path when this merges alone (parent D-13). The file count comes from one test file per new module, two small server routes that each need their route-scopes, no-loss and contract rows, twelve NFR-6 screenshots and three doc files; the work is split into 13 small items with explicit file scopes.

items.title: Add conversationBeside(paneId) to the Stage deck context (WI-1)

expected_outputs: openBeside.test.tsx passes, including the three new conversationBeside cases

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-1 exactly. Add the optional conversationBeside(paneId) field to StageDeckContextValue, implement it in Stage/index.tsx next to openBeside (first layout leaf other than paneId that is an agent pane bound to a known conversation), add it to deckContextValue and its deps, and extend openBeside.test.tsx.

items.title: Given a deck where openBeside split a conversation pane and a code pane, when conversationBeside(codePaneId) is called, then it returns that conversation object
Given an unsplit deck, conversationBeside returns null
Given a split of two code panes, conversationBeside returns null
Code pane header: root-label breadcrumb, File/Changes tabs and Reveal in files (WI-2)

expected_outputs: CodePaneHeader, CodePane and WorkDock tests pass

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-2 steps 1-6 (C-D1). Breadcrumb from useRootLabel(rootId) with › separators and the last segment in text-foreground; a role=tablist aria-label=Mode with File and Changes tabs replacing the Changes toggle; a LocateFixed Reveal in files button that sets this pane active and calls deck.openDock({ tab: 'files', reveal: { rootId, path } }); onOpenRenamed through deck.openBeside with the openCodePane fallback. Audit that WorkDock/changes tests assert openBeside for tree, Go to file, Changes row and Search hit; add any missing assertion. Viewer-only files keep their current rendering (C-D9).

items.title: Given label 'overdeck' and path 'docs/a.md', the header renders the breadcrumb 'overdeck › docs › a.md' with 'a.md' in text-foreground and never the project key
Clicking the Changes tab renders the ChangesView and clicking File returns to the plain editor; the old standalone Changes toggle button is no longer rendered
When Reveal in files is clicked, the pane becomes active and the dock opens on the Files tab with reveal { rootId, path }
When the ExternalChangeBanner's open-renamed action runs inside a Stage, it opens the new path through deck.openBeside({ rootId, path: newPath }), and outside a Stage it falls back to openCodePane
Server route GET /api/conversations/:name/changes/lines using git blame (WI-3)

metadata.parallelSafeReason: Server-only files (contracts, src/lib, routes, server tests); the only shared files (route-scopes.ts, no-loss-matrix.ts) are ordered before edit-changes-route by an edge.

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-3 steps 1-5 and decision C-D2 including its implementation checkpoint. Add ConversationChangedLines to the contracts; write getConversationChangedLines in src/lib/overdeck/conversation-change-lines.ts (lookup, file validation, getConversationChanges for commit shas and the uncommitted record, editedFiles writtenLines for attribution 'lines', async git blame --porcelain on the working tree, the untracked-file fallback, the marking rule, and the C-D2b cache keyed by HEAD, file stat and transcript stat with an injectable blame for tests); mount the route in conversation-diffs.ts next to getConversationChangesRoute with the same validateOrigin check; add the route-scopes, no-loss-matrix and EXPECTED_CONVERSATION_ROUTES rows. Async execFile only.

items.title: Given a repo where the conversation's trailer commit changed lines of a file and another commit changed others, the route returns only the trailer commit's working-tree line numbers

Given uncommitted lines in a shared file written by this conversation (attribution 'lines') and by another session, the route returns this conversation's lines and rejects the others (the fixture's 21-24 vs 25-26 shape)
Given attribution 'file', every uncommitted line of the file is returned; given an untracked new file the conversation wrote, its non-empty lines are returned
A file the conversation did not change returns 200 with lines []; file '../x' or an absolute path returns 400; an unknown conversation returns 404

Given a second call with HEAD, file and transcript unchanged, the route returns the cached lines and spawns no second blame; conversations-no-loss.test.ts and the no-loss matrix test pass with the route registered
Gutter marks for lines the scoped conversation changed (WI-4)

expected_outputs: changed-lines, useChangedLineMarks and CodePane tests pass
both new test paths appear in scripts/frontend-test-subset.txt

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-4 steps 1-5 (C-D3, C-D4). Pure toRepoPath and fetchChangedLines in changed-lines.ts; useChangedLineMarks reuses useScopeChangedPaths and useConversationChanges (same cache) and fetches FR-5 only for a file in the changes; one decorations collection per editor; no set while the draft is dirty; clear when the file leaves the changes or the conversation is null and on unmount. Wire it in CodePane with deck.conversationBeside(pane.paneId). Add the .monaco-editor .code-changed-line rule using var(--primary) to index.css.

items.title: toRepoPath returns the path for equal roots, the prefixed path for a root inside the repo, and null for a root outside the repo or a different worktree

Given a scoped conversation whose /changes/lines answer is [21,22,23,24], the hook calls the decorations collection's set with four whole-line ranges carrying linesDecorationsClassName 'code-changed-line'
Given a file not in the conversation's changes, the hook never requests /changes/lines and renders no marks
Given a dirty draft the hook does not call set, and given a null conversation it calls clear
Server route GET /api/explorer/edit-workspaces/:id/changes with per-file +/- and its client hook (WI-5)

expected_outputs: service, route and client tests pass

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-5 steps 1-5 (C-D5). Add EditWorkspaceChangedFile and EditWorkspaceChanges to contracts/explorer.ts; write getEditWorkspaceChanges with runGit only (merge-base with refs/remotes/origin/<default>, HEAD fallback; tracked numstat and name-status; untracked ls-files with a 2 MiB cap and the NUL-in-first-8192-bytes binary rule; uncommittedPaths from status porcelain v2); add handleEditWorkspaceChanges and the GET route to explorerEditWorkspacesRouteLayer; add the admin route-scopes row and the READ no-loss row; add fetchEditWorkspaceChanges and useEditWorkspaceChanges (invalidated on explorer watch batches of the edit root) to edit-workspace-http.ts.

items.title: Given an edit worktree with a modified, an added, a deleted, an untracked text file, an untracked PNG containing NUL bytes and a tracked binary plus a git-ignored file, the service returns the six files with additions/deletions (binary: true, 0/0 for both binaries) and omits the ignored file
Given a commit on the edit branch not yet on origin/<default>, its file appears in files counted against the merge base, and it is absent from uncommittedPaths
The route returns 401 without a credential, 404 ROOT_NOT_FOUND for an unknown workspace and 409 NOT_AN_EDIT_WORKSPACE for a non-edit row
fetchEditWorkspaceChanges requests /api/explorer/edit-workspaces/<id>/changes and throws ExplorerHttpError carrying the server code on a non-2xx answer
Carry cursor, scroll and focus across the edit-workspace root switch (WI-6)

expected_outputs: registry, switch and CodePane tests pass

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-6 steps 1-4 (C-D12). New view-state-registry.ts (registerCodeEditor, carryViewStates, takeViewState keyed by draftKey); switchRoot calls carryViewStates first and leaveEditWorkspace calls it before retargetPanes; CodePane restores a carried state and focus on editor mount and registers its current editor (the diff's modified editor while the diff is open).

items.title: Given a registered editor on project:p for docs/a.md, when switchRoot('project:p','workspace:w') runs, then takeViewState(draftKey('workspace:w','docs/a.md')) returns that editor's saveViewState() result and its focus flag
carryViewStates ignores editors whose key is not under the from-root prefix, and takeViewState returns null on a second call
Given a carried state with focused true, a CodePane that mounts on the new key calls restoreViewState with it and then focus()
Editor bar on project roots: main-checkout sentence, Start editing and landed notes (WI-7)

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-7 steps 1-5 (C-D9, C-D11). Add LandedNote, landed and setLanded to edit-workspace-store (setCreating(key, true) clears landed[key]); create EditorBar.tsx with EditWorkspaceNote moved verbatim from EditWorkspaceBanner.tsx (re-export it from EditWorkspaceBanner.tsx until WI-9 deletes that file), the project-root states (read-only sentence with Lock icon and Start editing calling ensureEditRoot, 'Creating edit workspace…', the three landed notes with Dismiss, Close tab and Open PR for pipeline); mount EditorBar in CodePane for project and workspace roots in place of the project note and EditWorkspaceNote. The workspace-root branch renders EditWorkspaceNote until WI-8.

items.title: Given a project root, the bar renders 'This is the main checkout. Start typing and Overdeck moves your edits to a new edit workspace, so main never changes until a PR merges.' and Start editing calls ensureEditRoot('project:<key>')
While creating[projectKey] is true the bar renders 'Creating edit workspace…'
Given landed notes of kind merged, pipeline and discarded, the bar renders the FR-11 sentences; Dismiss clears landed[projectKey] and Close tab calls closePane(deckKey, paneId)
Given an issue root, CodePane renders no editor bar
Editor bar on edit roots: files and +/-, Discard, Create PR, PR states with 15 s refresh (WI-8)

expected_outputs: EditorBar.test.tsx passes with at least 14 tests
metadata.parallelSafeReason: Touches only EditorBar.tsx, its test and edit-workspace-http.ts; every other item that edits those files is ordered before or after it by edges.

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-8 steps 1-4 (C-D6, C-D7, C-D10). Add PR_STATUS_REFETCH_MS = 15_000, shouldPollPr (C-D6: open, not draft, not mergeable, and UNKNOWN or BLOCKED) and the poll option to useEditWorkspaceStatus; implement the workspace-root states of EditorBar (pending, NOT_AN_EDIT_WORKSPACE, ROOT_NOT_FOUND from the status or the changes query -> onStale, other error + Retry, editing sentence with files/+/-/save state, PR open blocked, PR mergeable, merged on GitHub, closed); move the banner's merge/PR-done/discard/new-workspace handlers and unsaved guard into EditorBar, setting the landed note before leaveEditWorkspace. Port all 7 EditWorkspaceBanner.test.tsx and all 7 PrStatusRow.test.tsx cases to EditorBar.test.tsx and add the new cases. Use vi.useFakeTimers for the refetch test.

items.title: Given an edit root with two changed files totalling +6 -2 and no PR, the bar renders 'Editing in <name> on <branch> · 2 files changed +6 −2' with Discard… and a primary Create PR

Given an open PR with canMerge false and reason 'Required checks or reviews are not met', the bar renders 'PR #7 is open · Required checks or reviews are not met.' with Merge disabled and titled by the reason; given canMerge true and nothing uncommitted it renders 'no conflicts' with Merge enabled
Given a successful Merge, the bar calls setLanded(projectKey, { kind: 'merged', ... }) and then leaveEditWorkspace(rootId, projectKey); pipeline and discard results set their notes the same way

shouldPollPr returns true for an open non-draft PR whose mergeable or mergeStateStatus is UNKNOWN or whose mergeStateStatus is BLOCKED, and false for draft, DIRTY, BEHIND, mergeable and merged PRs; with fake timers the status query refetches after 15 000 ms for a BLOCKED PR and never for a DIRTY one
Given a status or changes query error with code ROOT_NOT_FOUND the bar calls onStale; given NOT_AN_EDIT_WORKSPACE it renders nothing; mounted without paneId it renders no Close tab
Files tab: remove the edit-workspace banner and add New edit workspace to the root menu (WI-9)

expected_outputs: the grep finds no import line naming EditWorkspaceBanner or PrStatusRow

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-9 steps 1-4 (C-D10). In ExplorerFiles replace the EditWorkspaceBanner block with <EditorBar rootId deckKey /> from ./edit/EditorBar (no paneId, so no Close tab), which keeps Create PR and Discard reachable after a tree-only edit; add a separator and a New edit workspace item to RootMenu that calls openNewEditWorkspace(deckProject.key, deckKey); delete EditWorkspaceBanner.tsx, PrStatusRow.tsx and their two test files and remove their lines from scripts/frontend-test-subset.txt (their cases already live in EditorBar.test.tsx).

items.title: Given an edit root without a PR in the Files tab, the tab renders the editor bar's 'Editing in' sentence with Create PR and Discard… and no Close tab button
When the root menu's New edit workspace is clicked, it creates an edit workspace through beginEdit(projectKey, true) and updates the deck's dock root override to the new root
Given the finished item, the grep for import lines naming EditWorkspaceBanner or PrStatusRow returns nothing and both files are deleted
Create PR dialog lists what will land and asks 'How should it land?' (WI-10)

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-10 steps 1-4 (C-D8). Replace the changedPaths prop with changes: EditWorkspaceChanges | undefined (EditorBar passes useEditWorkspaceChanges data); heading, from/into line, Title, Description (optional), 'What will land · N files +a −d' list, a radiogroup 'How should it land?' with the two described choices (disabled with the support reason when unavailable), Open as a draft for direct only, one primary button labelled by the choice; push mode keeps 'Commit and push' and lists only uncommittedPaths.

items.title: Given changes with two files, the dialog renders 'What will land · 2 files' and one row per file with its +/- counts
When Send through the pipeline is selected, the primary button renders 'Send through the pipeline' and Open as a draft is hidden; when Open a pull request is selected, it renders 'Open pull request'
Given pipelineSupport.available false, the pipeline choice is aria-disabled, shows its reason, and clicking it keeps the direct choice selected
Given an open PR, the dialog renders 'Commit and push', lists only files in uncommittedPaths, and submits mode 'direct' with draft false
Stale code tabs: 'merged or discarded' state with Open on main and Close tab (WI-11)

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-11 steps 1-3 (C-D13, C-D13b). New StaleCodeTab.tsx with isRootNotFound (PanRpcError and ExplorerHttpError) and the per-root-kind sentence, Open on main (retarget to project:<deck project key>, disabled with title 'This deck has no registered project' when none) and Close tab; CodePane renders it when readFile fails with ROOT_NOT_FOUND or when EditorBar calls onStale.

items.title: Given readFile rejecting with a PanRpcError code ROOT_NOT_FOUND on a workspace root, the pane renders 'This edit workspace was merged or discarded.' (data-testid code-pane-stale) and not 'Couldn’t open file'
Clicking Open on main updates the pane's explorerRootId to project:<deck project key>; with no registered deck project the button is disabled and titled 'This deck has no registered project'
Clicking Close tab calls closePane(deckKey, paneId); an issue root renders 'This issue's workspace no longer exists.'
A NOT_FOUND read still renders 'This file no longer exists.'
Fixture-backed Playwright spec and light/dark NFR-6 screenshots for screen 3 (WI-12)

verify_commands: cd src/dashboard/frontend && npx playwright test tests/pan-5290-editor-bar.spec.ts
expected_outputs: pan-5290-editor-bar.spec.ts passes against an isolated fixture dashboard
twelve PNG files exist under docs/screenshots/pan-5290/
metadata.parallelSafeReason: Adds only a new spec file and screenshots; it runs last in the DAG after every UI item it exercises.

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-12 steps 1-5 (C-D15). Model on tests/pan-5289-work-dock.spec.ts: isolated dashboard (own temp OVERDECK_HOME and fake HOME, never :3011, isolated Playwright browser profile), seed-workflow-fixture, DECK 'workflow-fixture', 1920x1000, serial, pageerror guard, header comment that it is not in CI's list. Real flow for the split, gutter lines (read .margin-view-overlays rows), Start editing with the cursor on line 15, the editing bar and the Create PR dialog; page.route stubs for PR open, mergeable and merge; a real discard plus reload for the stale tab. Save the twelve screenshots, open and inspect each against mockup screen 3, fix gaps, and attach them to the PR description.

items.title: Given conversation fixture-1 and docs/shared.md opened from the dock, both the conversation pane and the code pane are visible, and the margin rows carrying code-changed-line have line numbers exactly ['21','22','23','24']
Given the cursor on line 15 of a main-checkout file, clicking Start editing renders 'Editing in' in the bar, keeps the cursor on line 15, and the pane's root becomes workspace:

Clicking Create PR renders the dialog listing docs/shared.md with +/- and both landing choices; with stubbed status and merge routes the bar shows the PR-open state, then Merge renders the 'Merged PR' note on a project: root
After the edit workspace is discarded and the page reloads, a code tab on it renders code-pane-stale with Open on main and Close tab, and all twelve screenshots are saved
Document the editor bar, Create PR, gutter marks and stale tabs; add changelog.d/pan-5290.md (WI-13)

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-13 steps 1-4. Rewrite features/file-explorer.mdx 'Create PR and merge' as 'Editing and PRs' for the editor bar, extend 'Editing files' and 'Edit workspaces'; add the /changes route and 15 s refetch to docs/DASHBOARD-ARCHITECTURE.md 'Edit workspaces and PR routes (PAN-5191)' and a new 'Editor bar and gutter marks (PAN-5290)' subsection; add changelog.d/pan-5290.md with the text in the PRD. Correct .overdeck/context/codebase/architecture.md only if a statement about the banner is now wrong (leave its last-verified date unchanged).

items.title: features/file-explorer.mdx contains an 'Editing and PRs' section that names Start editing, 'How should it land?', Merge, Open on main and Close tab, and no sentence saying a banner offers Create PR

docs/DASHBOARD-ARCHITECTURE.md contains a 'Editor bar and gutter marks (PAN-5290)' subsection describing GET /api/conversations/:name/changes/lines and GET /api/explorer/edit-workspaces/:workspaceId/changes
